name: Breeze Easy® Visa® Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR for 12 billing cycles on balance transfers within 45 days of account opening, then 19.49% to 29.49%. Cash advance APR 29.74% variable. Minimum monthly interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee 5% (min $5). Cash advance fee 5% (min $10).

base_rate.description: Earn 1 BreezePoint for every $1 spent on all other Net Purchases.

categories.label: Nicer & Nicest Bundles (5X when you buy + 5X when you fly)
Nice Bundles (2X when you buy + 2X when you fly)
No Flex Flares (1X when you buy + 1X when you fly)

rewards.redemption_notes: Use BreezePoints how you want, whenever you want. BreezePoints never expire. No limit to total BreezePoints you can earn.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 30,000 bonus BreezePoints - that's a $300 value, plus Breezy 1 benefits, after spending $1,000 on purchases within the first 90 days.

benefits.title: Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Primary cardmembers and their companions receive Zone 1 priority boarding when traveling on flights operated by Breeze Airways.

benefits.title: Complimentary Inflight WiFi
benefits.description: With Complimentary Inflight WiFi, you can surf, stream and stay connected while you enjoy your flight on Breeze Airways.

benefits.title: Unlimited Points Earning
benefits.description: There's no limit to the total BreezePoints you can earn using your Breeze Easy Visa.

benefits.title: BreezePoints Never Expire
benefits.description: As a cardmember, your BreezePoints never expire. They're yours to earn and yours to burn for as long as you want.

benefits.title: Anniversary Bonus
benefits.description: Earn 7,500 Anniversary Bonus BreezePoints after every account anniversary with eligible purchases.

benefits.title: Breezy 1 Benefits
benefits.description: Earn Breezy 1 benefits including a Bundle Upgrade after spending $1,000 on purchases within the first 90 days.

benefits.title: Introductory APR on Balance Transfers
benefits.description: 0% introductory APR for 12 billing cycles on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. After that, variable APR 19.49% to 29.49%.
